name: charness
description: Tiny local GUI for Claude (Claude Agent SDK). Loopback only, no telemetry, no CDN, egress allow-list.

scripts.test:swift: swift build --package-path mac --product charness-server && CHARNESS_SERVER=mac/.build/debug/charness-server node test/smoke.mjs && CHARNESS_SERVER=mac/.build/debug/charness-server node test/compare-servers.mjs
